    • perPlayer

      default boolean perPlayer()
      Whether the drop should only be visible to the player who broke the block. Uses Paper API per-player entity visibility.

    • effectExplosion

      default boolean effectExplosion()
      Whether the dropped item should receive an explosive velocity effect.

    • effectGlow

      default DropGlow effectGlow()
      Optional glow effect configuration for the dropped item. When non-null and enabled, applies a colored glow outline via NMS.

    • effectBeam

      default DropBeam effectBeam()
      Optional beam effect configuration for the dropped item. When non-null and enabled, spawns a colored client-side particle beam from the drop location down to the ground.

    • itemsAdderId

      default String itemsAdderId()
      ItemsAdder namespaced item ID for this drop, e.g. "itemsadder:iron_crumble". When non-null, the drop will resolve via ItemsAdder API instead of Bukkit Material.

    • craftEngineId

      default String craftEngineId()
      CraftEngine namespaced item ID for this drop, e.g. "craftengine:custom_drop". When non-null, the drop will resolve via CraftEngine API instead of Bukkit Material.

    • mmoItemsId

      default String mmoItemsId()
      MMOItems item ID for this drop, e.g. "custom_drop". When non-null, the drop will resolve via MMOItems API instead of Bukkit Material.

    • experienceSource

      default String experienceSource()
      Source of experience for EXPERIENCE-type drops. Supported values: "vanilla" (default) or "mmocore".
      Returns:
      the experience source string, or "vanilla" if not set

    • mmocoreProfession

      default String mmocoreProfession()
      MMOCore profession ID for EXPERIENCE-type drops with mmocore experience source. Default is "main" which gives class experience. Can be a default MMOCore profession (alchemy, enchanting, farming, fishing, mining, smelting, smithing, woodcutting, etc.) or a custom profession from MMOCore.
      Returns:
      the MMOCore profession ID, or "main" if not set

    • dropPopup

      default DropPopup dropPopup()
      Optional popup effect configuration for the drop. When non-null and enabled, shows a floating text popup at the drop location.
      Returns:
      the drop popup configuration, or null if not configured
